plans.name: Starter
features: Reserve/operating fund enforced separation (CA Section 5550, FL Section 720.303(7), WA RCW 64.34.364)
Reserve-study deadline tracking for your state's statute
Dues tracking and online payments with receipts on record
Core homeowner directory and governance records
plans.whoItsFor: A single volunteer board self-managing one community up to 50 homes
plans.outcome: Start with cleaner reserve records and an easier treasurer handoff
plans.notIdealFor: Multi-community operators or property managers billing multiple clients.

plans.name: Growth
features: Reserve/operating fund enforced separation (CA Section 5550, FL Section 720.303(7), WA RCW 64.34.364)
Reserve-study deadline tracking for your state's statute
Governance records with full audit trail on owner requests
Owner portal with request visibility and audit-trail (FL Section 720.303(5), CA Section 4525)
Automated dues reminders and delinquency tracking
plans.whoItsFor: A mid-size volunteer board that needs owner-facing operations alongside fund compliance
plans.outcome: Keep reserve records clearer and give owners a place to check requests
plans.notIdealFor: Communities under 50 homes that only need fund separation and basic recordkeeping. Starter covers that

plans.name: Scale
features: Reserve/operating fund enforced separation (CA Section 5550, FL Section 720.303(7), WA RCW 64.34.364)
Reserve-study tracking with per-community deadline alerts
Governance records plus financial packet exports
Owner portal with request visibility and audit-trail (FL Section 720.303(5), CA Section 4525)
General ledger and core financial reports
Audit-packet exports formatted for CA/FL/WA statutory review
Month-end close workflow with attested balances
plans.whoItsFor: A larger self-managed community that needs audit-grade reporting and month-end close
plans.outcome: Export the financial packet an auditor or lender may ask for
plans.notIdealFor: Small boards that don't yet need audit-pack exports, month-end close, or a general ledger. Growth covers that

config.trialBannerText: The board keeps the record. Annual billing is selected by default.
config.promoText: Limited time offer: 80% off the first year. Use M80OFF monthly or Y80OFF yearly.

faqs.question: Is pricing per door?
faqs.answer: No. Pricing is flat per community size and billed annually.

faqs.question: Can we try it before the board commits?
faqs.answer: Yes. Start the trial and evaluate the workflow before billing begins.

faqs.question: What happens if we outgrow a tier?
faqs.answer: Move to the tier that matches the community size. The record stays intact.

faqs.question: Do you give legal advice?
faqs.answer: No. Gavelhouse is an operating tool, not legal counsel.

faqs.question: Can we export records?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can export records for board review.

faqs.question: Who answers questions?
faqs.answer: Email angel.campa@gavelhouse.app and the builder answers.

faqs.question: How much does Gavelhouse cost?
faqs.answer: Annual billing is the default. With Y80OFF, Starter is about $10/mo, Growth is about $27/mo, and Scale is about $50/mo when billed annually. Monthly billing is available with M80OFF. There are no per-unit fees.

faqs.question: Does Gavelhouse handle reserve fund compliance?
faqs.answer: Yes. Gavelhouse keeps reserve and operating money separate. It also keeps the board record easier to review.

faqs.question: How long does setup take?
faqs.answer: Most boards can start the same day. Add owners, dues, and funds. Then use the board workflow.

faqs.question: Do I need to sign an annual contract?
faqs.answer: No. Month-to-month. Cancel anytime. Use Y80OFF yearly or M80OFF monthly for 80% off your first year.

faqs.question: What size community is Gavelhouse built for?
faqs.answer: Gavelhouse is for self-managed communities up to 500 homes.

faqs.question: Can I try Gavelhouse before paying?
faqs.answer: Yes. Start the trial and keep the 30-day money-back guarantee.
